AGENDA
  GLENDALE SPECIAL ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire
devices using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings
are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818)
548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City
Clerk's Office. For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public
comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed. If you have
any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the Library,
Arts and Culture Department, at (818) 548-2030, during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E.
Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Special Meeting

  Thursday, February 21, 2023, at 10:00 a.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on February 21, 2023, at 10:08 a.m.
  •  Present: Commissioner Vidor, Yank, Zadorian Vice Chair Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar
  •  Absent: Commissioner Yank
  •  The Agenda for the February 21, 2023, Special Meeting was posted on February 15, 2023, on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (INCLUDING MINUTES)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the Commission or the
  audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the January 9, 2023 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

  Moved:  Commissioner Tufenkian
  Seconded :  Commissioner Vidor

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vidor, Zadorian, Vice Chair Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Yank
  Abstain:  None

3. INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones,
  Principal Arts & Culture Administrator

  4. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS - NONE

  5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes. Members of
  the Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the Speaker, but there will be no Debate or
  Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  • No Speakers

6. ACTION ITEM(s)
  a. City-Wide Public Art Landmarks RFQ #2 – LeBasse Projects
  1. Motion approving the proposed locations for public art landmark pieces to be included as part of the
  City-Wide Public Art Landmarks RFQ #2, and the application review process to be managed by
  LeBasse Projects on behalf of the City of Glendale.

  •  LeBasse Projects provided the Commission with an update on their work to date and presented
  proposed landmark artwork locations for the remaining 4 sites for consideration and discussion by
  the Commission.
  •  Commission asked questions and gave their input.

  1
   That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves the proposed locations (1,2,3 and 5 with
  location 4 being a wildcard in case one location is not acceptable) for public art landmark pieces to
  be included as part of the City-Wide Public Art Landmarks RFQ #2, and the application review
  process to be managed by LeBasse Projects on behalf of the City of Glendale, as more fully
  outlined in the February 21, 2023 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture
  Administrator.

  Moved:  Commissioner Vidor
  Seconded :  Commissioner Zadorian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vidor, Zadorian, Vice Chair Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Yank
  Abstain:  None

b. 2023 - 2024 Work Plan
  1. Motion approving the programs and projects for the 2023-2024 Work Plan, in an amount not to
  exceed $2,200,000 from the Urban Art Fund, and to recommend the City Council’s approval of the
  Plan.
  • Staff presented a budget analysis on estimated expenditures for the 2022-2023 Work Plan, in
  addition to proposed recommendations for programs and projects for the 2023-2023 Work Plan
  which will be from July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024.
  • Commission asked questions and gave their input.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby:
  1. Approves the programs and projects for the 2023-2024 Work Plan (“Plan”), in an amount not to
  exceed $2,200,000 from the Urban Art Fund, as more particularly outlined in the February 21,
  2023 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator; and
  2. Recommends that the City Council approve the Commission’s Plan.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Commissioner Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vidor, Zadorian, Vice Chair Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Yank
  Abstain:  None

c. Arts and Culture Commission – Meeting Date/Time
  1. Resolution approving Resolution No. 2023-01 related to Commission Rules of Procedure and
  adopting new Rules of Procedure that:
  •  Staff recommended that the Arts and Culture Commission adopt a Resolution approving
  Resolution No. 2023-01 related to Commission Rules of Procedure and adopting new Rules
  of Procedure that: (a) Reschedule the date and time of the Arts and Culture Commission’s
  Regular Meeting to the 3rd Thursday of each month, 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM.

  (a) Reschedule the date and time of the Arts and Culture Commission’s Regular Meeting to the 3rd
  Thursday of each month, 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM

  2
   Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Commissioner Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vidor, Zadorian, Vice Chair Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Yank
  Abstain:  None

7. DISCUSSION ITEM(s) / REPORT(s)
  a. 2022-2023 Work Plan Progress Updates
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. Mural Ordinance – Update
  • Staff is working with Ms. Odenkirk on drafting a draft Mural Ordinance and Policies and
  Procedures and will be scheduled for initial review by the Commission at an upcoming
  Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.
  • Commission asked questions and gave their input.

  2.  NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS- No Update
  3.  PERFORMING ARTS – No Update
  4.  ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No Update
  5.  MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that staff invited the two finalists for the Public Relations firm
  opportunity to attend the March 16th meeting to present their proposals for the
  Commission’s consideration.

8. COMMISSION / STAFF COMMENTS
  •  Commissioner Tufenkian stated she attended the L.A. Art show where Reflect Space was invited to
  participate.
  •  Commissioner Vidor stated she wanted to thank Commissioner Yank for her work as Chair on the
  Commission and congratulated Commissioner Viar and Commissioner Tufenkian for being appointed
  as Chair and Vice Chair. Commissioner Vidor extended her thanks and gratitude to the Staff of
  Glendale Arts and Culture.
  •  Commissioner Zadorian thanked Commissioner Yank for her work as Chair on the Commission and
  congratulated Commissioner Viar and Commissioner Tufenkian for being appointed as Chair and Vice
  Chair. Commissioner Zadorian also stated that she is currently meeting and in discussions with the
  current Mayor Ardy Kassakhian and hopeful future Mayor Dan Brotman who are chairing the Armenian
  Genocide Commemoration event. Commissioner Zadorian also stated that the Poet Laureate is one
  step closer to finalizing and choosing a Poet Laureate and is looking forward to sharing the outcome.
  •  Chair Viar thanked everyone for their comments and thanked staff for their work and hoped to see
  everyone at Be the Change Book Festival.

9. ADJOURNMENT
  The next Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission is March 16, 2023, at 10:00 a.m., in
  City Council Chambers (2nd Floor), 613 E. Broadway.
